text:
anna_ops: Quick check — we need to reshape quota for tenant acme-inc to free up 4 A100s for the east-demo pool next week. Current plan is to move 6 GPUs out of the staging demo slice, keep 2 for smoke tests. Who owns the quota change?
kevin_infra: I can take the quota side. Do we want a permanent carve or a temporary reservation for next Mon-Fri?
sara_prod: temporary reservation is fine, timeline is tight: deploy canary on Tue, full canary Wed. If we can secure 4 A100s via reservation Mon morning that should cover it.
kevin_infra: OK will submit reservation request to cloud vendor. Need tenant ID + current project quotas. anna_ops can you post the project IDs and which racks to pull from?
anna_ops: acme-prod-1 and acme-staging-3. Prefer pulling from acme-staging-3 first (lower traffic). Rack suggestion: eu-west1-a100-rack-12 (if available).
kevin_infra: Thanks. Running quick check: `gcloud compute reservations list --filter="name~a100" --regions=eu-west1` — will paste results in a sec.
vendor_bot: [vendor update] Request received: reservation for 4 x A100 (eu-west1). ETA for allocation: 18-24h. Quote attached.
kevin_infra: vendor ETA looks OK. Two followups: 1) do we need billing approval for a short-term reservation? 2) any tenant-specific compliance lock to be aware of when moving GPUs between projects?
sara_prod: Finance pre-approved up to $X/day for demo bursts — we should still add the reservation to the monthly report. No extra compliance locks for acme, it's standard infra.
oncall_ryan: For safety, add fallback policy to routes: if reservation fails, route demo traffic to spot fallback pool (latency bump acceptable). I'll add the routing tag to the canary config.
kevin_infra: Filed reservation PR: https://git.internal/infra/terraform/pull/482 — includes `google_compute_reservation` + `allocations` for acme-staging-3. @sara_prod can you +1 finance note in PR? pr-bot: PR #482 checks passed (plan-only).
anna_ops: Quick nit: update the TTL to 5d not 3d so we don't have churn if deploy slips.
kevin_infra: Good call. Edited PR. New plan shows reservation start Mon 08:00 UTC, TTL 120h.
sara_prod: +1 from product for dates.
oncall_ryan: I'll patch the canary routing to include `fallback: spot-blend` and add a short delay before traffic shift. Should limit RTO.
kevin_infra: After vendor confirms allocation I'll apply. Leaving a note here: if vendor returns with partial allocation (2/4), we'll carve the remaining from eu-west demo warm pool and update routing.
anna_ops: Sounds good — thanks all. I'll follow up tomorrow AM with final tenant billing code and the rack serials if needed. :thumbsup:
vendor_bot: [vendor update] Allocation confirmed: 4 x A100 reserved in eu-west1-rack-12, reservation id res-98431. ETA: applied in 2h.
kevin_infra: Applying in ~10m (will post apply log).
kevin_infra: apply output: `Apply complete! Resources: 1 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed.` reservation id res-98431.
anna_ops: Verified from console — machines show in acme-staging-3. Kicking off canary smoke now.
oncall_ryan: Canary smoke green. Rolling canary to 10% and monitoring latency (will report in #incidents if anything spikes).
sara_prod: Great work. Leaving note for postmortem if anything regresses.
anna_ops: Thread closed unless someone needs more changes.
